summary: 56 units reviewed, 21 marked fix; 5 error-level issues, 36 minor; 39 machine-applicable patches. Errors: unit 26 (dṛśyamāneṣu agrees with saṅgheṣu: 'when the saṅghas are seen', not the planted objects), unit 42 (yoga-striyaḥ in apposition to the rich widows: agents posing as widows, not a separate class), unit 55 (line unparseable as printed; a person must check the printed Kangle reading, possibly 'tisandhānebhyo; no variant asserted). Minor: glossary consistency (sattrin = गुप्तचर in Hindi units 6, 25, 31, 41, 44; tīkṣṇa without the inline gloss 'नामक गुप्तचर' in 8; daṇḍa = army/दण्ड in 23; aṭavī = आटविक in 30; eka-rāja = एकराज in 54; kārtāntika = soothsayer in 21, 49, distinct from mauhūrtika = astrologer), unmarked additions removed or marked (9 'of others', 35 'the woman's', 38 'kill him', 44 'to live', 26 'उन वस्तुओं'), genitive link restored in 7, abl. label in 10, confidence lowered to medium in 13. Text flags: 38 kriḍā->krīḍā confirmed; 44 kullam->kulam agreed as 'possible' but a person should check the printed text. pravāsayet in 33/47 = 'do away with' kept, matching the GLOSSARY entry from 12.3 and confirmed by 48 (brahmahā). chindikā (9) accepted at medium confidence. No regrouping suggested. Items for a person: 55 (reading), 42 (what the Aditi-Kauśika women are), 44 (kullam). GLOSSARY.md extended with the 11.1 terms.
